source_note: TREAT AS DEMO. Workspace is a paid client build that was never live (pre-launch testing on the client's WhatsApp number); lead.isDemo=false is a flagging gap, not real traffic. Customer side = a Singapore tester (not a real renter); it was the same day a car-rental prospect's contact was sent to try this bot as a reference, so likely prospect-side testing. The top-pick message was sent with a car photo (not included). Trimmed to the first 12 messages; the next exchange (IDR->SGD conversion) was cut because its rough rate was imprecise. Redactions: customer initials -> placeholder, business and agent name -> placeholders.

messages.text: How much to rent a car in bali?

Hi there! 👋 I'm [agent name] from [Business] — happy to help you find the right car!

May I know your name first?

Nice to meet you, Ryan! 🚗

Are you looking to *self-drive*, or would you prefer a *car with a driver*?
mostly self drive but can consider with driver depend on the cost.

Got it, Ryan! Self-drive to start 👍

What are your travel dates, and how many days are you planning to rent?
How many passengers will there be?
And how many bags/luggage are you bringing?

My top pick for you: *Toyota All New Avanza* 🚗

• *Self-drive:* IDR 500.000/day × 7 days = *IDR 3.500.000 total*
• *With driver:* IDR 850.000/tour × 7 tours = *IDR 5.950.000 total*

Seats 4–6 comfortably, fits your luggage, and it's a great all-rounder for exploring Bali at your own pace.

Would you like this one, or shall I show you other options?
